components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font:700 1rem var(--font-sans);text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s var(--ease),background .2s var(--ease),border-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease)}.ds-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--color-primary) 0%,var(--color-primary-dark) 100%);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(31,122,92,.32)}.ds-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(31,122,92,.4)}.ds-primary:active{transform:translateY(0)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-primary);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Outline button
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font:700 1rem var(--font-sans);text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s var(--ease),background .2s var(--ease),border-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease)}.ds-outline{background:transparent;border-color:var(--color-border);color:var(--color-primary-dark)}.ds-outline:hover{border-color:var(--color-primary);background:var(--color-primary-light)}.ds-outline:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-primary);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font:700 1rem var(--font-sans);text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s var(--ease),background .2s var(--ease),border-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease)}.ds-secondary{background:var(--color-surface);border-color:var(--color-border);color:var(--color-text)}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--color-primary);background:var(--color-primary-light)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-primary);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive record of the built landing system, not a replacement identity. Warm off-white surfaces, forest green, restrained gold, Inter text and Manrope headings are confirmed brand commitments in PRODUCT.md. The composition is spacious and practical, with rounded interactive controls and lightly elevated landing cards.

The blog extends that system with reading columns, editorial dividers and semantic figures. Its page-specific story and composition remain in `.impeccable/surfaces/blog.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces and forest-green text.
Manrope headings with Inter reading text.
Pill buttons, rounded panels and restrained gold accents.
Flat editorial lists and explanatory figures alongside the landing page's lifted cards.

rules.name: The Inheritance Rule
rules.body: New surfaces use the incumbent palette and existing type families; the editorial extension does not establish a second brand.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep explanatory prose within the implemented article measure and preserve the wider line spacing used for sustained reading.

dos: **Do** inherit the existing warm palette, type families and rounded controls.
**Do** preserve readable article measures, semantic figures and keyboard-visible focus.
**Do** keep RTL layout, direction indicators and localized numbering meaningful.
**Do** distinguish live Home workflows from future-edition previews.
donts: **Don't** replace the incumbent identity when extending an established surface.
**Don't** turn editorial figures into invented product screenshots.
**Don't** treat the landing's pre-existing decorative eyebrows, glyph icons or detector findings as reusable rules. They were outside this extension's repair scope and are not canonized here.
